notes:
Account summary: SummitBridge is a mid-enterprise payments processor focused on healthcare payers and billing reconciliation. They've built a payments orchestration platform and want to add LLM-driven workflows for claims triage, customer support chat, and embedding-powered document search. They process card payments (PCI scope) and handle PHI via claims metadata (HIPAA impact).

What they told us: 'We need a private deployment we can show to internal security and run legal reviews against; must support BAA + PCI SAQ evidence and KMS with HSM-backed keys.' — Head of Security (K. Montgomery).

Key compliance ask: Map Redwood Private VPC architecture to SOC 2 control families, ISO 27001 Annex A references, HIPAA technical safeguards (encryption, audit logging, access controls), and PCI DSS scope reduction strategies (tokenization + minimized PAN exposure). They expect a compliance mapping doc and an artifact list (attestations, runbooks, network diagrams).

Recent activity / timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-02-28: Intro call + security scoping (Fireflies ID FF-78214) — AE + SE + Head of Security attended. Initial ask: BAA + PCI evidence + KMS HSM.
- 2026-03-03: Shared initial architecture sketch (private control plane + customer VPC, VPC peering, Transit Gateway) — SE follow-up with questions on egress controls and S3 access patterns.
- 2026-03-05: Legal sent preliminary checklist for BAA + PCI SAQ (attached Drive doc).
- 2026-03-07: POC kickoff approved by product — dev VPC provisioned, sample scrubbed dataset uploaded to dev bucket, audit logging pipeline stubbed to Splunk.
- 2026-03-09: Security team requested KMS compatibility matrix and recommended HSM vendors; scheduled deep-dive.

POC scope: 2-week POC in customer-controlled VPC, private control plane, inbound-only peering, audit logs forwarded to customer Splunk, KMS integration using customer-managed keys. Success metrics: immutable audit log of inference requests, ability to rotate and revoke keys, latency within 120ms p95 for short chat flows, and proof of tokenization for PCI-relevant fields.

Compliance mapping needs (requested by their security lead):
- SOC 2: map data access controls, change management, vendor mgmt, logging/monitoring to Redwood's controls and artifacts (SOC 2 Type II expected for production).
- ISO 27001: map Annex A controls relevant to crypto key mgmt, network segregation, supplier relationships, and information classification.
- HIPAA/BAA: identify how Redwood Private supports technical safeguards (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls, audit trails), and what Customer must own (e.g., de-id before upload, BA amendments).
- PCI: outline SAQ/ROC impact, options for reducing scope (tokenization, not storing PAN, using Redwood for embeddings only vs. full payment flow).

Quotes / friction: lots of legal/infosec caution. Security requested explicit list of artifacts (SOCs, pen-test reports, configuration baselines, encryption algorithms and key lengths, KMS integration guide). Network engineering concerned about VPC peering egress costs and cross-account role assumptions.

Open items:
- Provide KMS/HSM compatibility matrix + sample Terraform module for KMS IAM roles.
- Produce compliance mapping deliverable (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/PCI) tailored to the private VPC architecture.
- Confirm retention/archival options for audit logs and support for customer-managed SIEM ingestion.
- Clarify responsibility split in BAA for PHI exposure in embeddings and logs.

Next steps (short):
- 2026-03-12: Scheduled deep-dive with infra + KMS vendor (SE + security + KMS vendor rep).
- 2026-03-20: Target SOW finalization and procurement kickoff.
- Legal to confirm required attachments for contract (SOC2 report, BAA template, PCI scoping note).

Sales notes (AE): prioritize compliance mapping deliverable and a short security-runbook tailored to SummitBridge flows. Emphasize that Redwood Private enables customer-owned VPC + KMS and gives artifact/attestation package to accelerate legal signoff. Keep POC tight — show audit/logging + key rotation in 2 weeks.

Stitched links: Drive SOW draft, security FAQ folder, FF transcript, Jira tickets (SEC-423 for KMS questions).
